missingCityMessage: 무대(도시·거리)에 맞는 장소가 재료 서랍에 없어요 · 자동 추가가 켜져 있으면 만들어 쓰고, 꺼져 있으면 재료에서 먼저 추가해 주세요.
promptLines: STORY SHAPE — 찾기-오답형: Looking for one thing and finding the wrong things that look or sound like it (a shell that is a flower); each miss teaches something; found in a surprising place that was there all along. Refrain idea: 'Is it this? No, it is a …' once per beat. Lean on this shape; it is a spark, not a checklist.

STAGE — 자연 · 바다: The sea — sand, waves, shells, gulls, a lighthouse, rock pools; wet feet and salt wind. The supplied places that fit this stage carry the story; name no real city or country unless the topic does.

Places: settings[].backgroundId and beat.settingKey are supplied background IDs only. The story happens where the topic puts it — here 조개빛 바닷가: open there (a home ID only when the topic begins at home or names no place) and stay as long as the story wants; move to another supplied place only when the story needs it, never to show every place in the drawer. The last beat happens wherever the parent's ending puts it.
